input.query: find mid-cap DeFi tokens with rising volume

output.query: find mid-cap DeFi tokens with rising volume

api_query.endpoint: /v3/cryptocurrency/listings/latest (keyless) or the keyed Pro listings/latest equivalent selected by CmcClient
api_query.client_side_filters: All explicit thresholds, category/ecosystem tags, age, turnover and risk bounds are checked against returned CMC fields and reported per result.

results.name: Lido wstETH

risk.name: Lido wstETH
risk.formula: 25 liquidity/turnover + 25 volatility + 15 market size + 15 dilution proxy + 10 pair breadth + 10 listing age = 100 (higher = higher measured risk)

components.name: Liquidity / turnover
components.explanation: Turnover is 24h volume divided by market cap, log-scaled from 0.0005 (riskiest) to 0.25 (least risky).

components.name: Volatility
components.explanation: Weighted daily volatility = 50% |24h| + 30% (|7d|/sqrt(7)) + 20% (|30d|/sqrt(30)); 15% or more receives full points.

components.name: Market size
components.explanation: Market cap log-scaled from $1M (riskiest) to $100B (least risky).

components.name: Dilution proxy
components.explanation: FDV/market-cap ratio log-scaled from 1x (no measured dilution gap) to 10x (full points). This is a supply/dilution proxy, not holder-concentration data.

components.name: Market-pair breadth
components.explanation: Number of CMC market pairs log-scaled from 1 (riskiest) to 10,000 (least risky); a breadth/access proxy, not holder concentration.

components.name: Listing age
components.explanation: Listing age log-scaled from 7 days (riskiest) to 10 years (least risky).

risk.caveat: Transparent market-structure score only. CMC listings data used here does not expose holder concentration; pair breadth and FDV/market cap are labelled proxies, not ownership measurements. Not financial advice.
